items.title: From headlines to hard data: mapping the uneven impact of geopolitical risk in Europe
U.K. Home Sales Fall on Budget Uncertainty, Report Says
items.summary: Sales fell 4% across the U.K., with buyer demand down 12% on year on fears of higher property taxes in the budget, according to a report by real-estate agency Zoopla.
